method: After freezing the pair, reopened the dated catalogue groups, individual course requirements and underlying active workbook evidence. Checked programme architecture, progression and academic limitations before comparing with the frozen records.
findings: Reopened catalogue page 40659 and independently totalled each year from the required groups. The two first years total 60 EC each. Year three contains 30 EC of open choice, 18 EC of other requirements and 12 EC split between Research Project and Skills. Both thesis courses run in periods 5–6. The two dated entries show 120 EC preparation, with the March 1 condition specifically for company projects. The individual thesis and prototype belong to the research course. The companion course teaches design science, feedback, project management and responsible AI. The 12 EC internship requires 90 EC and fits within the choice group.

Reviewed the applied methods from the dated unit records before checking UCR comparisons. Deterministic operations research develops linear, integer and network models. The stochastic course adds queueing, simulation, robust optimisation and Markov decisions. The workbook supports genuine partial overlap through linear programming, discrete optimisation and probabilistic decisions, while the UCR course combinations have no comparable two-course operations research sequence. Language Technologies covers classification, translation, text processing and language-model use. Neural Networks overlaps on text classification and generation, with its own image and time-series emphasis. Marketing Analytics teaches purchase, choice and media-mix models, whereas Market Research covers question design, collecting evidence and interpreting customer preferences.

Reopened workbook offerings, prerequisite cells and topic or description evidence. BENBUSI211 is available in fall 2028, and moving Accounting and Corporate Finance to fall 2026 lets both business-facing options keep the original 24 choices. Introductory Data Science remains before Machine Learning and Database Management fits spring 2028. In the technical option, Advanced Algorithms follows Algorithms and Data Structures in spring 2028. The final spring includes AI optimisation and reinforcement learning after Python, numerical methods and the AI decision course. The technical option loses deep-learning coverage and still has regression, classification and substantive optimisation. The market route keeps empirical econometrics and market research and adds distinct consumer, digital strategy, finance and international business contributions. The closest route integrates these subject areas in a more balanced composition. Reconciled the 4, 4 and 8 course pairwise differences and separate UCR optional research against the frozen pair.

Checked the final title, three labels and concepts, programme explanation, academic year, module names, notes, sources and course descriptions by the established record-to-renderer mapping. All 32 selected descriptions match prior reviewed display text, course titles and evidence hashes. The study description and options use ordinary reader-facing language, distinguish the audience-facing limits, and do not import internal progress, provenance or generation commentary.
